description: Explicit development-only namespace enrollment command. No normal processor registration enables this resource. All actions require current Create permission.

action.description: Inspect retained metadata, claim enrollment, or capture current owner scope without writer authority.
action.title: action

deletionIntentID.description: Exact retained deletion intent for InspectDeletion only.
deletionIntentID.title: deletionIntentID

granted.description: True only for an acknowledged live attempted-to-claimed CAS.
granted.title: granted

namespaceID.description: Exact native namespace incarnation. Required except for CaptureScope, which forbids this field.
namespaceID.title: namespaceID

operationID.description: Exact source-owned creation operation. Required except for CaptureScope, which forbids this field.
operationID.title: operationID

registryID.description: Exact participant registry ID, equal to namespaceID. Required except for CaptureScope, which forbids this field.
registryID.title: registryID

snapshot.description: Validated source-owned namespace-enrollment.v1 metadata, never caller authority.
snapshot.title: snapshot

title: NamespaceParticipation
